FIIS NET BUYERS AT ₹4,195.38 CRORE ON 17 NOV

On 17 November 2026, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) were net buyers of ₹4,195.38 crore in the cash market, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) were net buyers of ₹196.93 crore.

November so far (2 sessions): FIIs +9,060.06 crore, DIIs -3,322.12 crore.

In derivatives, FIIs held 33.4% of their index futures positions long (net -65,123 contracts, -8,436 from the previous session). Net index calls: -1,16,830; net index puts: +3,69,613 contracts.
